meta.note: Rows describe the work, not a value. A row with a source links to the official page that would supply the value; a row with no official source says so and links to nothing.

rows.item: Replace city and county proxies with trade-area figures
rows.exists: City and county figures, each with its official link: People and place, and Economy and jobs.
rows.missing: Trade-area boundary and Census tract figures. A trade area cannot be drawn without the parcel location, which this workflow does not hold.
rows.needs: Parcel location, used only in a secure workflow (private input).

rows.item: Extend the private worksheet to a sell-versus-hold comparison
rows.exists: Sell-versus-hold calculator: after-tax cash from a sale and the present value of the hold path, side by side, with rates from the verified tax ledger. No winner is selected.
rows.missing: The owner's own figures: sale price, costs, tax basis, depreciation, rent and rates. A verified lease abstract.
rows.needs: Private inputs, entered by the owner or an authorised adviser.

rows.item: Decision-gate progress board
rows.exists: The plan and decision rule are written out on the Decision analysis page.
rows.missing: A tracked board that shows each gate's status and the evidence that closes it.
rows.needs: Owner's choice of gates and their closing evidence.

rows.item: Parcel-level hazard screening
rows.exists: Regional hazard context (earthquake, fire, flood, risk index) on the Hazards and insurance pages, each with its official link.
rows.missing: The parcel's own zone status for earthquake, fire and flood; engineering and insurance reports.
rows.needs: Parcel location in a secure workflow; private engineering and insurance reports.

rows.item: One-page printable summary for advisors
rows.exists: Advisor summary: verified counts, blocked items, first questions, and the calculator, laid out to print on one page.
rows.missing: Nothing public. The owner's private figures are added offline by the advisor.
rows.needs: None for the public page.

rows.item: A private calculator that runs in the reader's browser
rows.exists: Sell-versus-hold calculator. Runs in the browser; no network call, no storage, blank inputs.
rows.missing: Nothing for the tool itself.
rows.needs: Owner's own figures to produce a result.

rows.item: Neighbourhood-level data around the parcel
rows.exists: City and county figures only.
rows.missing: Census tract and neighbourhood figures for the parcel's surroundings.
rows.needs: Parcel location in a secure workflow.

rows.item: An after-tax module
rows.exists: Federal capital-gain, depreciation-recapture, net investment income and California rules, from the verified ledger, combined in the calculator.
rows.missing: The owner's tax position (income level, basis, depreciation), entered privately.
rows.needs: Private inputs.

rows.item: Price the short-lease discount from real quotes
rows.exists: The projection model has a labelled assumption for the extra yield a buyer demands when a lease is about to expire. The model's own note says no official source measures it. It is not priced from quotes.
rows.missing: Real quotes for lease-term offers on this property, with dates and sources.
rows.needs: Quotes from brokers or buyers. No official source publishes these, so none is linked.

rows.item: Tract-level trend evidence alongside the regional figures
rows.exists: Regional (city and county) figures with their trends.
rows.missing: Tract-level series for the trade area.
rows.needs: Tract selection, which needs the parcel location (W-01).

rows.item: Keep identifiers, lease files and owner finances offline; publish only aggregate findings
rows.exists: The published tree is scanned for personal information on every build; no owner or parcel record is in the repository (Privacy page).
rows.missing: The offline, access-controlled store itself is outside this repository. The public Pages source is still the whole repository until the owner changes it (see Deployment).
rows.needs: Owner action on the Pages source setting.

rows.item: Use the location only in a secure workflow to select Census tracts and local planning, traffic, school and competitor evidence
rows.exists: County public school enrollment is published with its official link (People and place). Nothing else for this list is in the repository.
rows.missing: Tract selection, planning (zoning) lookups, traffic counts and competitor locations. None of these is in the repository.
rows.needs: Parcel location in a secure workflow.

rows.item: Privately check seismic, flood and fire maps, engineering and insurance; stress loss of rent, repairs and exit liquidity together
rows.exists: The model runs stress cases (tenant trouble, site damage, higher rates, vacant-building value, sale costs) on the Projections page. Repair costs are not in the model.
rows.missing: Parcel map checks, engineering and insurance quotes, repair-cost estimates, and a single stress case that combines loss of rent, repairs and exit liquidity.
rows.needs: Private engineering and insurance reports.

rows.item: Versioned cash-flow model, back-tested when verified inputs and comparable history exist; observations kept apart from assumptions
rows.exists: A versioned scenario model in which anchors (verified rows) and labelled assumptions are kept apart. It reproduces its output exactly. It has not been back-tested.
rows.missing: Comparable sale or lease history, and the owner's cash-flow inputs, needed for a back-test.
rows.needs: Comparable history from official or transaction records; owner inputs.

rows.item: Turn the verified tax rules into one number the owner can compare with the hold case
rows.exists: The calculator's difference line: sale after-tax cash minus the hold path's present value.
rows.missing: Nothing for the tool itself. The number is only as good as the inputs.
rows.needs: Private inputs.

rows.item: Replace regional hazard context with the parcel's zone status for earthquake, fire and flood
rows.exists: Regional hazard context only (see W-04).
rows.missing: The parcel's zone status.
rows.needs: Parcel location in a secure workflow.

rows.item: Same-store sales, unit counts, closures and franchise rent, showing direction rather than one quarter
rows.exists: Same-store sales for two quarters and two fiscal years: [[TN-020]] [[TN-022]] [[TN-023]] [[TN-024]]. Restaurants in the system: [[TN-001]] now, [[TN-004]] a year earlier, [[TN-007]] at fiscal year-end. Closures in the latest quarter: [[TN-005]]. Franchise rent in the latest quarter: [[TN-028]].
rows.missing: A series of more than two points for each measure, from the company's filings.
rows.needs: Reading each prior filing for the same measures.

rows.item: Research on the area: geography, income, schools, population, jobs and other economic factors
rows.exists: City and county figures are published with official links (People and place; Economy and jobs; Hazards and insurance).
rows.missing: Neighbourhood level (F-02) and tract level (F-05).
rows.needs: Parcel location (W-01).

rows.item: Commission a private lease abstract and reconcile it with the notice calendar
rows.exists: The public record holds no verified lease terms for this property. The exact expiry date is open (question Q01).
rows.missing: The lease abstract, and the notice and option calendar it would produce.
rows.needs: Owner's lease documents, read by an authorised adviser (private).

rows.item: Executive summary
rows.exists: Executive summary page.
rows.missing: Nothing for the page itself.
rows.needs: None.

rows.item: Suggestions section for review; no change made before review
rows.exists: Suggestions for Review page; nothing has been implemented from it.
rows.missing: Owner's choice of which suggestions to take.
rows.needs: Owner's choice.

rows.item: List of questions, information and answers needed before a decision
rows.exists: Questions to answer page: each question with what is known, what is missing and who can answer.
rows.missing: Answers to the open questions, which need private or outside inputs.
rows.needs: Answers from the owner, advisers or the sources named.
